observations: Photo 0 shows a bright, overexposed image of a screen with faint text and a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI LEXIBEATZ'.
Photo 1 shows the back of a monitor with a label clearly displaying 'LG' brand, model '27UK650-W', and other specifications including 'MADE IN CHINA / FABRIQUE EN CHINE'.
Photo 2 shows a white box with 'hp' logo and text '25xw Monitor', indicating a different monitor in packaging, possibly new or unused.
The seller claims to have 'this and two more monitors available', implying at least three monitors are for sale, but only one is shown in detail (LG 27UK650-W).
The seller claims the monitor is 'clean used and working perfectly no issues never been...'.

claims.claim: clean used and working perfectly no issues never been...
claims.evidence: No photo shows the monitor turned on or in use. No close-up of screen or ports. The condition is not visually confirmed.

claims.claim: I have this and two more monitors available
claims.evidence: Only one monitor (LG 27UK650-W) is shown in detail. Photo 2 shows an HP monitor box, which may be one of the 'two more', but it is not confirmed if it is included or in what condition.

risks.risk: Monitor may not be working or may have screen defects (dead pixels, burn-in, etc.)
risks.proof: A video or photo of the monitor turned on, displaying a test pattern or normal use, with close-ups of the screen.

risks.risk: The monitor may have physical damage not visible in the photos (scratches, cracks, dents)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the front and sides of the monitor, especially bezel and screen edges.

risks.risk: The 'two more monitors' may not be available or may be different models (e.g., the HP box in photo 2 may be new, not used)
risks.proof: Photos of all three monitors, clearly showing each one's brand, model, and condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as only one monitor available

proof_requests: Video or photo of the LG 27UK650-W monitor turned on, showing screen quality.
Close-up photos of the front and sides of the LG monitor to check for damage.
Photos of the other two monitors, including their brands and models, to confirm availability and condition.
response.reason: The identity of the main monitor is confirmed as LG 27UK650-W, but the seller's claims about its working condition and the availability of two additional monitors are unverified. Without proof of functionality and condition, the item cannot be priced accurately. The HP box in photo 2 adds ambiguity about what is being sold.
